definition: rule only by a woman or women.
example_en: The purely-female kingdom is mentioned in the puranas.

definition: a buffalo that has a grown up calf.
example_en: That buffalo with a grown calf is grazing in the field now.

definition: the back of the hip.
example_en: He hurt the back of his hip while falling.

definition: a water-jug with a handle and a snout to pour water.
example_en: Grandmother poured water from the spouted water-jug.

definition: the sun, the lord of the day.
example: ಪ್ರಾಚೀನ ಕವಿಗಳು ಸೂರ್ಯನನ್ನು ವಾಸರಪತಿ ಎಂದು ಕರೆಯುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Ancient poets call the sun the lord of the day.

definition: a member of a people or group with a civilization regarded as primitive, savage, etc.
example: ಆ ಕಾಡಿನಲ್ಲಿ ವಾಸಿಸುವ ಗಗ್ಗ ಜನಾಂಗ ಸರಳ ಜೀವನ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The primitive tribe living in that forest leads a simple life.

definition: a senior officer in a palace; royal-official.
example_en: The royal officer looked after all the affairs of the palace.

definition: bound by chain or fetters; fettered; shackled.
example_en: The prisoner was in jail, shackled with fetters.

definition: that which is not going far.
example_en: That small village was not far from the town.

definition: a woman who hates or is hated.
example_en: That woman who hated others looked at everyone with malice.

definition: a monetary coin of very low value.
example: ಹಳೆಯ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿಳ್ಳಾಣಿ ಎಂಬ ಕಡಿಮೆ ಬೆಲೆಯ ನಾಣ್ಯ ಬಳಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿತ್ತು.
example_en: In olden times, a low-value coin called killani was in use.

definition: to fill water into.
example_en: She filled water into the pot and brought it home.

definition: (dial.) something done or said intentionally to cheat another; fraud; trickery; cheating.
example: ಅವನ ಎಡ್ಡಿನಿಂದ ನಾನು ನನ್ನ ಹಣವನ್ನು ಕಳೆದುಕೊಂಡೆ.
example_en: Because of his trickery I lost my money.

definition: a mountainous region.
example_en: It rains heavily in the mountainous region (Malnad).

definition: veryhigh; tall; lofty.
example_en: That tower was so lofty it seemed to touch the sky.

definition: to divide into two parts or branches; to bifurcate.
example_en: The river bifurcated into two branches.

definition: a boon, generous or gracious gift, blessing, etc.
example_en: God gave the devotee a boon.

definition: a man of virtue.
example: ಆ ಹೂನ್ಯವಂತ ಸದಾ ಸತ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಧರ್ಮದ ಹಾದಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That man of virtue always walked the path of truth and righteousness.

definition: the pleasure of sexual union.
example_en: The couple experienced the pleasure of sexual union.

definition: a character denoting a number; a numerical figure.
example_en: The page number was written on the page.

definition: the period of a political or social revolution.
example: ಆ ದೇಶ ಕ್ರಾಂತಿಯುಗದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಲವು ಬದಲಾವಣೆ ಕಂಡಿತು.
example_en: That country saw many changes during the period of revolution.

definition: to reach (something) by stretching one's hand.
example_en: He stretched his hand and reached the fruit.

definition: a man who beheads another; a decapitator.
example_en: That decapitator was given a punishment.

definition: a big hallow place in a hillside, with an opening, extending back horizontally; a cave; a cavern.
example_en: The travellers took shelter in the cave in the hillside.

definition: suddenly; all of a sudden.
example_en: The door shut suddenly.

definition: the part of the body between the ribs and the hips; the waist.
example_en: She held her waist in pain.

definition: much money or property; riches; wealth.
example_en: He distributed his wealth to the poor.

definition: a kind of venomous insect.
example_en: The place where the venomous insect stung is hurting.

definition: a small enclosure made of railings supported by small posts, around a spot; a balustrade.
example_en: A stone balustrade has been built around the temple.

definition: a dishonoured, disgraced family.
example_en: Nobody mentions the name of his disgraced family.

definition: purified; filtered; sifted.
example_en: Drinking filtered water is good for health.

definition: not cooked properly.
example_en: The improperly cooked rice could not be eaten.

definition: money paid for the use of money taken on loan.
example_en: He had to pay interest on the loan.

definition: the flames or blaze of light, to rise.
example_en: As the flames rose in the stove, the cooking began.

definition: a defying of an order; the act of defying another's order.
example: ರಾಜನ ಆಜ್ಞಾಭಂಗ ಮಾಡಿದ ಸೈನಿಕನಿಗೆ ಕಠಿಣ ಶಿಕ್ಷೆಯಾಯಿತು.
example_en: The soldier who defied the king's order received a harsh punishment.

definition: the business of operating a farm; farming; agriculture.
example_en: His farming depends on the rain.

definition: gone out; flowed out; driven or forced out.
example_en: The people were driven out from that region.

definition: to see; to behold.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ತುದಿಯಿಂದ ಅವನು ಇಡೀ ಊರನ್ನು ಆಲಿಗೊಂಡನು.
example_en: From the top of the hill, he beheld the entire town.

definition: lack of honesty; a disposition to lie, cheat or steal; deceiving; dishonesty.
example_en: Everyone was deceived by his dishonesty.

definition: a thin strip of wood cut or chiselled out from a bigger piece.
example_en: The carpenter peeled off a thin strip of wood from the timber.

definition: not destructible; that cannot be destroyed; indestructible; permanent; immortal.
example_en: This gold ornament is not indestructible.

definition: he who is partially speechless , intentionally or as from fright.
example_en: Being partially speechless, he did not speak out of fear.

definition: to receive a gift, by getting water poured formally by the giver on the gift, making the gift irrevocable.
example: ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಮಗುವಿನ ತಲೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ನೀರು ಧಾರೆಗೊಳ್ಳುವ ಮೂಲಕ ಆಸ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ದಾನ ಮಾಡಿದಳು.
example_en: The grandmother made the gift of the property irrevocable by pouring water over the child's head.

definition: the hair at the lower part of the abdomen surrounding the external genitals; pubes.
example_en: Pubic hair is a part of the body.

definition: Dattātrēya, a Hindu-god with three faces.
example: ಭಕ್ತರು ತಿಮೊಗನನ್ನು ಮೂರು ಮುಖಗಳ ದೇವರೆಂದು ಪೂಜಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Devotees worship Timoga as the three-faced god.

definition: the social institution under which a man and woman establish their decision to live as husband and wife by legal commitments, religious ceremonies, etc.; marriage.
example_en: Their marriage took place according to the scriptures.

definition: the act or condition of being associated congruously and coherently; coherence; congruity.
example_en: Good coherence is seen in these sentences.

definition: completely protected, guarded.
example: ಆ ಗುಹೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಸೈನಿಕರು ಸಮಾಶ್ರಿತ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಅಡಗಿದ್ದರು.
example_en: The soldiers were hiding in a well-protected place in that cave.

definition: observing religious rites and rituals scrupulously.
example_en: That brahmin performs worship scrupulously observing the rites.

definition: (fig.) a man born of parents not married to each other; an illegitimate son.
example: ಊರಿನ ಜನ ಆ ದುರ್ಬೀಜನನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಮುಖ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The villagers turned their faces away upon seeing that illegitimate son.

definition: either of the two flaps tied to the sides of the eyes of an ox, turning the oil mill, to prevent from seeing to the sides; blinker.
example_en: They tied the blinkers on the ox's eyes and turned the oil mill.

definition: to come to life; to begin one's life.
example_en: The newborn child came to life.

definition: the skill of archery.
example_en: His skill in archery impressed everyone.

definition: strong desire, esp. for wealth; avarice; greed; cupidity; avarice.
example_en: Greed led him down a bad path.

definition: to be feverish; to have fever.
example_en: The child has had fever since night.

definition: a loan with a stipulation to be repaid within a definite period; a term loan.
example: ರೈತನು ಬ್ಯಾಂಕಿನಿಂದ ಅವಧಿಸಾಲ ಪಡೆದು ಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟರ್ ಖರೀದಿಸಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer took a term loan from the bank and bought a tractor.

definition: a piece of old cloth.
example_en: The grandmother wiped the floor with a piece of old cloth.

definition: (mus.) the initial stage in the development of a rāga (musical mode).
example_en: The musician began the rāga from its opening stage.

definition: an expert in the science of the universe, the stars, planets position, movement, etc.; an astronomer.
example_en: That astronomer discovered a new planet.

definition: of this kind, sort.
example_en: She likes that kind of flowers.

definition: something swollen; an abnormally swollen part of the body; swelling.
example_en: A swelling appeared on the leg from the injury.

definition: Gaṇēśa, whose vehicle is a mouse; the rat-rider.
example_en: People worship the idol of Gaṇēśa, the rat-rider.

definition: a decimal fraction in which after certain point one figure or group of figures is repeated to infinity; (e.g. ⅓ = 0.3333….333333).
example_en: The maths teacher gave an example of a recurring decimal.

definition: minced pieces; fragments.
example: ಒಡೆದ ಗಾಜು ಫುಟಾಫುಟಿಯಾಗಿ ನೆಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿದ್ದಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The broken glass lay on the floor in minced fragments.

definition: a wing of a bird.
example_en: The bird's wing flapped in the wind.

definition: a large kettle or boiler; a cauldron.
example_en: They cooked rice for the festival in the large cauldron.

definition: to talk quietly or furtively, as in gossiping; to whisper.
example_en: Two women were whispering in the corner.

definition: a language of the Dravidian family.
example_en: Munda is a language belonging to the Dravidian family.

definition: to disregard, reject, be contemptuous of or be intolerant of, others' opinions, beliefs etc.
example_en: He always disregards the opinions of others.

definition: a man who inhabits some specified place; a resident; an inhabitant.
example: ಈ ಬೀದಿಯ ರಹವಾಸಿಗಳು ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಹಬ್ಬ ಆಚರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The residents of this street celebrated the festival together.

definition: to move slightly from the original position.
example_en: The stone moved slightly from its place.

definition: an arresting or being arrested; a taking or being taken into custody.
example_en: The police carried out the arrest of the thief.

definition: a small piece taken out from a whole; a fragment.
example_en: She cut a fragment from the cloth.

definition: (Jain.) a soul which does not deserve or is not eligible for, the final emancipation; a soul which is engrossed in the non-spiritual activities only.
example: ಜೈನ ಗ್ರಂಥದ ಪ್ರಕಾರ ಅಭವ್ಯ ಜೀವ ಮುಕ್ತಿಗೆ ಅರ್ಹನಲ್ಲ.
example_en: According to Jain scripture, an abhavya soul is not eligible for liberation.

definition: indecent, abominable censure.
example: ಅವನ ಖಳಕಳಂಕವನ್ನು ಕೇಳಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮುಖ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Hearing his indecent censure, everyone turned their faces away.

definition: a thinking of something beforehand; previous consideration; anticipation; premeditation.
example: ಮುಂದೆಣಿಕೆ ಇಲ್ಲದೆ ಅವನು ಆ ನಿರ್ಧಾರ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡನು.
example_en: He took that decision without any prior consideration.

definition: a particular kind of service to the deity in temples.
example_en: The paruvete service to the deity was conducted in the temple.

definition: the act of entering; entrance.
example_en: The entrance of the school faced east.

definition: a women in her menses period.
example: ಪುಷ್ಪಿತೆ ಆದ ಕಾರಣ ಅವಳು ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋಗಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: Because she was menstruating, she did not go to the temple.

definition: to have good quality, virtue or good qualities, virtues.
example_en: A good person always possesses good virtues.

definition: knowledge of the fact; perfect knowledge.
example: ಅವನಿಗೆ ಈ ವಿಷಯದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಉಳ್ಳರಿತ ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: He had perfect knowledge about this matter.

definition: the state or fact of being naked; nakedness.
example_en: The saint's nakedness surprised the people.

definition: suffering; pained; distressed; afflicted.
example: ಆ ಕ್ಲಿಶಿತ ಮನುಷ್ಯನನ್ನು ಕಂಡು ಮನಸ್ಸು ಕರಗಿತು.
example_en: The heart melted seeing that distressed man.

definition: every year.
example_en: They celebrate that festival every year.

definition: an immodest, shameless man.
example_en: In the assembly, that shameless man spoke without any modesty.

definition: a glass bottle.
example_en: He filled the oil into a bottle.

definition: salary that is paid by cash.
example_en: The company pays the employees salary in cash.

definition: overpowering wonder or suprprise; astonishment; amazement.
example_en: Everyone was astonished at his courage.

definition: a struggle or fight; a conflict.
example_en: A conflict took place between the two.

definition: name of a country.
example_en: The merchants from the country of Mapari came.

definition: a small trumpet.
example_en: The boy played while blowing a small trumpet.

definition: any of a genus (Corvus, family Corvidae) of large, nonmigratory passerine birds with glossy black plumage and a typical harsh call; a crow.
example: ಕಬ್ಬಿಲೆಯು ಮರದ ಮೇಲೆ ಕೂತು ಕಾ ಕಾ ಎಂದು ಕೂಗಿತು.
example_en: The crow sat on the tree and cawed.

definition: to give courage to; to cause to be bold or bolder; to embolden.
example_en: The teacher's words gave the student courage.

definition: to be wasted; to go waste.
example_en: His effort went waste without bearing fruit.

definition: a discharging or removing or being discharged or removed from office or service, etc.; dismissal; removal.
example_en: The order of dismissal was given to that soldier.

definition: an ornament for the ear.
example_en: The bride wore the kannavacca ear ornament.

definition: the art or work of ornamenting fabric with needlework; embroidering; embroidery.
example_en: Grandmother embroidered the sari.

definition: a flowing incessantly.
example_en: The waterfall's water flowed incessantly.

definition: a detailed account of something.
example_en: The officer examined the detailed account of the expenditure.

definition: an able, strong man.
example_en: That able, strong man pulled the cart alone.

definition: a centre of population larger or more important than a town or village; a city.
example_en: Bengaluru is a big city.

definition: a mound of earth, leaves, etc., formed by a colony of ants in digging or constructing their underground nest, in which snakes dwell; an ant-hill.
example_en: A snake was living in that ant-hill.

definition: an impassioned lover.
example: ಆ ಶೃಂಗಾರಿ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯೆಗಾಗಿ ಪದ್ಯ ಬರೆದನು.
example_en: That impassioned lover wrote a poem for his beloved.

definition: the act of disappearing; a going out of sight.
example_en: His disappearance surprised everyone.

definition: a small piece or fragment of a whole.
example_en: A small fragment of bread remained on the plate.

definition: the female of Bos grunniens with stocky, long-hair yak.
example_en: The female yak lives in the high regions of the Himalayas.

definition: a cloud of interstellar gas or dust; a nebula.
example_en: Astronomers discovered a new nebula.

definition: the wife of a Vaiṣṇava dāsa.
example: ದಾಸಗಿತ್ತಿ ತನ್ನ ಗಂಡನ ಜೊತೆ ದೇವಸ್ಥಾನಕ್ಕೆ ಹೋದಳು.
example_en: The wife of the Vaiṣṇava dāsa went to the temple with her husband.

definition: any of several flammable, gas or liquid solution of hydrocarbons, occurring naturally in the rock strata of certain geological formations; a petroleum product.
example_en: The price of petroleum has risen again.

definition: a person employed by a government to get secret information about or monitor the affairs, plans, armed forces, etc. of another government; a spy.
example_en: The enemy camp's spy gathered secret information.

definition: any of various wolflike carnivores (family Hyaenidae), with powerful jaws, a bristly mane, short hind legs, and a characteristic shrill cry, fed on carrion; a hyena.
example_en: At night the cry of a hyena was heard.

definition: to move or be moved quickly and irregularly up and down, back and forth or from side to side; to shake oneself.
example: ಚಳಿಯಿಂದ ಅವನು ಪೊಡರ್ ಪೊಡರ್ ಎಂದು ನಡುಗಿದನು.
example_en: From the cold he shook and trembled all over.

definition: a thick mixture of mud and water.
example_en: After the rain, the path was filled everywhere with thick mud and water.

definition: that which consists of or has something within.
example_en: This box consists of valuable objects within it.

definition: to make a sound or sounds.
example_en: The bell was making a sound in the temple.

definition: to cause to enter into; to make something go in.
example_en: She made the water go inside the bottle.

definition: the colour between or made by mixing or blending white and black; grey.
example: ಬೆಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಆಕಾಶ ಧೂಸರ ಬಣ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The sky above the hill had turned grey.

definition: put forth buds; budded.
example_en: The rose plants in the garden were budded.

definition: any of various slender, soft-bodied animals, some segmented, that live by burrowing underground, in water or as parasites, including the annelids, nemerteans, nematodes, platyhelminths, acanthocephalans, and gordian worms; a worm.
example_en: After the rain a worm appeared in the ground.

definition: a man who works; a workman; a worker.
example_en: That workman toils from morning till evening.

definition: a friend; an intimate companion.
example_en: I run every day with my close friend.

definition: to be turned upside down; to be overturned.
example_en: The boat was overturned by the storm.

definition: a soldier trained in the use of cannons, mounted heavy-guns, etc.; an artilleryman.
example_en: The artilleryman prepared the gunpowder.

definition: to think carefully about, esp. in order to make a decision; to contemplate; to reflect on; to consider.
example_en: He did the work after considering it carefully.

definition: the chief of an army.
example_en: The army chief devised the battle strategy.

definition: to give a form by sculpturing.
example: ಶಿಲ್ಪಿ ಕಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಕಡೆಗೆಯ್ದು ಸುಂದರ ಮೂರ್ತಿ ಮಾಡಿದನು.
example_en: The sculptor sculpted the stone into a beautiful idol.

definition: squinting; looking askance or sidelong; squint.
example: ಅವನ ಮೆಳ್ಳೆ ನೋಟ ನನಗೆ ಗೊಂದಲ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: His squinting look confused me.

definition: the mulberry shrub or tree Morus alba of Moraceae family, grown mainly for its leaves for feeding silkworms; white mulberry.
example: ರೈತರು ಹಿಪ್ಪುನೇರಳೆ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಸಿ ರೇಷ್ಮೆ ಸಾಕುತ್ತಾರೆ.
example_en: Farmers grow white mulberry plants and raise silkworms.

definition: excessive joy or pleasure; delight.
example_en: Immense delight was seen in the child's smile.

definition: to direct the course or motion of.
example_en: That person showed us the way to the village.

definition: to join (onself) with; to be associated with.
example_en: He agreed to join and associate himself with that team.

definition: the front portion; frontage.
example_en: There is a beautiful flower garden in the front portion of the house.

definition: a term used to proclaim "leave room for".
example: ರಾಜನ ಸವಾರಿ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ, ಸಂಬಳಿ ಎಂದು ಸೇವಕರು ಕೂಗಿದರು.
example_en: The king's procession is coming, the servants shouted, asking people to leave room.

definition: (mus.) a mode of keeping time (now obs.).
example: ಆ ಹಳೆಯ ಗ್ರಂಥದಲ್ಲಿ ಜಾಂಬಾಯರ ಎಂಬ ತಾಳದ ವಿವರಣೆ ಇದೆ.
example_en: That old treatise gives a description of the time-measure called jāmbāyara.

definition: the act, manner or power of flying or moving through space (as of birds, aircrafts, etc.); flight.
example_en: The flight of the parrots could be seen all over the garden.

definition: the lethargic attitude that makes a person lazy.
example_en: The work is not progressing because of his lazy attitude.

definition: a man who saw or can give a firsthand account of, something; a witness.
example_en: In the court, the witness told what he had seen.

definition: boyishness; childishness.
example_en: His childishness has still not gone away.

definition: having considerable linear extent in space or time; long.
example_en: That river flows for a very long distance.

definition: the act or process of joining, uniting together.
example: ಎರಡು ನದಿಗಳ ಯೋಗ ಆ ಸ್ಥಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: The joining of the two rivers happens at that place.

definition: the procession of a bridegroom.
example_en: The bridegroom's procession went around the whole village.

definition: to bring together; to cause to assemble; to collect; to congregate.
example_en: They brought the relatives together for the festival.

definition: great danger; peril; jeopardy.
example: ಆ ಪ್ರಯಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಅವರಿಗೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿಪತ್ತಿ ಎದುರಾಯಿತು.
example_en: They faced great peril during that journey.

definition: the astringent taste.
example_en: The raw mango has an astringent taste.

definition: a male ruler of a nation or state usu. called a kingdom; a king; a ruler; a monarch.
example: ಆ ದೊರೆ ತನ್ನ ಪ್ರಜೆಗಳನ್ನು ನ್ಯಾಯದಿಂದ ಆಳಿದನು.
example_en: That king ruled his subjects justly.

definition: a removal of an evil, inauspicious thing, etc. or a warding off, preventing (something evil) from happening.
example: ಪೂಜೆಯಿಂದ ಮನೆಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಕೇಡುಗಳ ನಿವಾರ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: Through the ritual, all evils of the house were warded off.

definition: any of the consonants, following the first one in a cluster of conjugated consonants, written in an abbreviated form below (the first one).
example_en: The conjunct consonant is written below this letter.

definition: (dance) the lifting up of the head obliquely and keeping it in that position for a moment to show one's body with pride, self-adulation, etc.
example: ನರ್ತಕಿ ಆಧೂತ ಮಾಡಿ ತನ್ನ ಸೌಂದರ್ಯವನ್ನು ಪ್ರದರ್ಶಿಸಿದಳು.
example_en: The dancer lifted her head obliquely and displayed her beauty.

definition: calm; composed.
example_en: Everyone liked his calm nature.

definition: a person who praises, adulates or admires; an adulator; an admirer.
example_en: The disciple was an admirer of his teacher.

definition: a shapeless mass; a lump clod (of earth).
example_en: Lumps of earth were lying in the field.

definition: the act, fact or an instance of swinging back and forth; dangling.
example_en: The swinging of the cradle lulled the baby to sleep.

definition: to cease to live; to die.
example_en: Bitten by the snake, he died.

definition: the fact of (a large number of people) sitting for discussion, entertainment, etc.
example_en: Today evening, a gathering (baithak) will take place in the village.

definition: a connected group; a cluster; a bunch.
example_en: A bunch of grapes was hanging on the vine.

definition: to do or perpetrate an offence of crime.
example: ಅವನು ಮೋಸದ ಕೆಲಸವನ್ನು ತಪ್ಪಿಸಿದನು ಎಂದು ಆರೋಪಿಸಲಾಯಿತು.
example_en: He was accused of having perpetrated the fraudulent act.

definition: having inertia; without power to move or act; intert.
example_en: The fallen stone lay there inert, without power to move.

definition: (fem.) a specialist in geology; a geologist.
example_en: She is a famous geologist.

definition: short pants extending to just above the knee; bermuda shorts.
example_en: In summer he wears bermuda shorts.

definition: to flash (like a lightning) for a very brief period.
example_en: The lightning flashed briefly in the sky.

definition: that cannot be imagined; unimaginable.
example_en: The consequence of that event was unimaginable.

definition: a man who loves; a lover.
example_en: Being her lover, he stood by her in her troubles.

definition: lacking soundness of mind; mentally ill, mad; insane.
example: ಅವನೊಬ್ಬ ಪುಚ್ಚ ಮನುಷ್ಯ, ಯಾರ ಮಾತೂ ಕೇಳುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He is an insane man; he listens to no one.

definition: a man who is the pride of the Kuntaṇa (Kuntala), the northern part of the present Karnāṭaka.
example_en: Everyone was proud that he was the pride of Kuntala.

definition: that which causes detestation or abhorrence.
example: ಆ ಬಿಬ್ಬಚ್ಚ ದೃಶ್ಯವು ಎಲ್ಲರಿಗೂ ಅಸಹ್ಯವನ್ನು ಉಂಟುಮಾಡಿತು.
example_en: That detestable sight caused disgust in everyone.

definition: a fat, corpulent man.
example_en: That corpulent man sat in the chair with difficulty.

definition: to state something in detail or add more details; to elaborate.
example_en: She elaborated her story further.

definition: the quality or fact of being slippery; a sliding; a slip.
example_en: The slipperiness of the path increases during the rainy season.

definition: sodium borate, a white, anhydrous, crystalline salt, Na2B4O7, with an alkaline taste, used as a flux in soldering metals and in the manufacture of glass, enamel, artificial gems, soaps, antiseptics, etc.; borax.
example: ಗಾಜಿನ ತಯಾರಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳುಗಾರ ಒಂದು ಪ್ರಮುಖ ವಸ್ತು.
example_en: Borax is an important substance in glassmaking.

definition: a platform projecting from the wall of an upper floor of a building and enclosed by a railing; a balcony.
example_en: I stood on the balcony and looked at the street.

definition: the shape of a circle; roundness.
example_en: The circular shape of that garden looked beautiful.

definition: the spinal column; backbone.
example_en: As he aged, his backbone gradually bent.

definition: a kind of myrrh-like gum resin.
example_en: In Ayurveda, this myrrh-like gum resin is used as medicine.

definition: a small house.
example: ಅವರು ಊರ ಹೊರಗೆ ಒಂದು ಕಿರುಮನೆ ಕಟ್ಟಿಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದಾರೆ.
example_en: They have built a small house outside the village.

definition: a cavity; hallow.
example_en: There was a large cavity in the rock.

definition: the wild dog Canis aureus, (smaller than the wolf), which often hunt prey in pack at night and eat carrion and cretin plants, believed to be sly; jackal.
example_en: The jackal caught the chickens at night.

definition: the knotted braid.
example_en: Her knotted braid was very beautiful.

definition: to keep, place (things) in a particular or required order.
example: ಗ್ರಂಥಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ರಮವಾಗಿ ನೇರಿಡು ಎಂದು ಗ್ರಂಥಪಾಲಕ ಹೇಳಿದರು.
example_en: The librarian said to arrange the books in proper order.

definition: to become cheerful, merry or lively.
example: ಹಬ್ಬದ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಮಕ್ಕಳ ಮನಸ್ಸು ಪುಲ್ಲವಿಸಿತು.
example_en: Hearing the news of the festival, the children's hearts became cheerful.

definition: a man struck by the anguish caused by seperation of his lover or unfulfilled sexual desire.
example_en: Struck by the anguish of separation from his beloved, he became distraught.

definition: a meeting, deliberation of a king in his court-hall, with his counsel of ministers and others partaking.
example: ರಾಜನ ದರಬಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಂತ್ರಿಗಳು ಮುಖ್ಯ ವಿಷಯ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: The ministers discussed an important matter in the king's court.

definition: to graft - a) to insert (a shoot or bud) as a graft; b) to insert a graft of (one plant) in another.
example: ರೈತನು ಸೇಬಿನ ಮರಕ್ಕೆ ಹೊಸ ಗೆಲ್ಲನ್ನು ಕಶಿಕಟ್ಟಿದನು.
example_en: The farmer grafted a new branch onto the apple tree.

definition: a state of pain, distress or grief; misery.
example_en: The misery of poverty afflicted that family.

definition: a variety of bee that is small in size.
example: ಪುತ್ತಿಕೆಗಳು ಗೂಡಿನ ಸುತ್ತ ಗುಯ್ ಗುಯ್ ಎಂದು ಹಾರುತ್ತಿದ್ದವು.
example_en: The small bees were buzzing around the hive.

definition: the musical voice or sound.
example_en: A sweet musical sound came out from the bamboo flute.

definition: to cause to become unsteady; to cause to shake, quiver.
example_en: The strong wind caused the door to shake.

definition: historic or pre-historic times; ancient times.
example_en: In ancient times, people lived a simple life.

definition: a kind of mask used as an insignia by a king, head of a monastery, etc.
example_en: The monastery head's insignia mask was displayed at the festival.

definition: to enter into; to come into.
example_en: The child said it would enter into the house.

definition: stacking one above the other; a piling up.
example_en: The stacking of firewood was in the backyard of the house.

definition: any worm.
example_en: There was a worm in the fruit.

definition: empty; worthless; valueless; hollow.
example_en: No one believed those hollow words.

definition: immediate nearness in place; proximity.
example_en: The shop is in the immediate proximity of the school.

definition: excessiveness; abundance; excellence in quantity or quality.
example: ಆ ವರ್ಷ ಬೆಳೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಣಿಯರ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: That year there was good abundance in the harvest.

definition: boyish play or playfulness.
example_en: Boyish playfulness was going on in the school ground.

definition: a downy or furry growth on the surface of organic matter, caused by fungi, esp. in the presence of dampness or decay; mold.
example_en: Mold had grown on the wall due to dampness.

definition: that which is conquered, subdued.
example_en: The enemy's army was conquered.

definition: to give or furnish as a natural process or as the result of cultivation; to yield.
example: ಈ ವರ್ಷ ಮಾವಿನ ಮರ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಫಲಕೊಟ್ಟಿತು.
example_en: This year the mango tree yielded well.

definition: a man as related to a woman, with whom he has a sexual or romantic relationship; a lover.
example: ಅವಳ ಕಾದಲ ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಅವಳಿಗೆ ಪತ್ರ ಬರೆಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: Her lover wrote her a letter every day.

definition: renewed vigour.
example_en: After the treatment, it felt as if renewed vigour had come to him.

definition: a man who is sitting or standing without moving.
example: ಆ ಸ್ತಿಮಿತಕಾಯ ಗೋಡೆಯ ಬಳಿ ಸುಮ್ಮನೆ ನಿಂತಿದ್ದನು.
example_en: That motionless man stood quietly near the wall.

definition: to raise to a higher place; to lift up; to elevate; to hoist.
example_en: He raised the flag up on the pole.

definition: an agreement (as for sale, supply, etc.); a contract.
example_en: The contractor entered into a contract with the government.

definition: a subordinate who has been granted endowment of a few villages by his king, for the military support.
example_en: The king granted three villages to the military subordinate.

definition: a general merchant.
example_en: That general merchant has a shop in the market.

definition: not having any taste; tastelessly.
example_en: This rice is tasteless.

definition: a multitude or assemblage of kings.
example_en: An assemblage of kings had gathered at that meeting.

definition: to solemnly promise something or decidate oneself for a particular cause, way of life, etc.
example_en: He solemnly dedicated himself to the service of the nation.

definition: intense inclination, deep interest a person has towards.
example: ಸಂಗೀತದ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನಿಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಲೋಲಾಪ್ತಿ ಇದೆ.
example_en: He has intense inclination towards music.

definition: an acrid, bitter young shoot.
example_en: The acrid young shoot of this leafy plant is very bitter.

definition: any of a class of chemical elements, as iron, gold or aluminum, generally characterised by ductility, malleability, luster, and conductivity of heat and electricity; a metal.
example_en: He weighed the metal and sold it.

definition: the disc of the sun.
example_en: The sun's disc appeared red in the evening.

definition: (anat. zool.) a small cavity or hollow, as a cell of a honeycomb, air cell of a lung, tooth socket, etc.; an alveolus.
example_en: Oxygen enters through the alveoli of the lungs.

definition: the process of gradual, progressive change or development in one's life.
example_en: His progressive development in life became possible through education.

definition: any of a series of rapid, heavy breaths, as from exertion; gasp; pant.
example: ಓಟದ ನಂತರ ಅವನ ಮೇಗುಸಿರ್ ಜೋರಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿಸುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: After the run, his heavy panting could be heard loudly.

definition: the confidence reposed in a person who has been given nominal ownership of property, which is to be kept, used or administered for another's benefit; trust.
example_en: He was entrusted with the property under trust.

definition: (gram.) a word that can be used both in masculine and feminine gender.
example_en: This word is used as both masculine and feminine gender.

definition: to force to go; to push (someone) out or away.
example_en: The guard pushed the stranger out.

definition: to make weak or weaker; to weaken; to overpower.
example_en: The defeat weakened his self-confidence.

definition: those people who can trace their descent from a common ancestor; a house, a lineage; a family.
example: ನಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಈ ಊರಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಹಳ ವರ್ಷಗಳಿಂದ ವಾಸಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: Our family has been living in this town for many years.

definition: name of a petty goddess.
example_en: They lit a lamp before the goddess Malabe.

definition: a maid servant or a male servant, esp. one appointed for menial work.
example_en: They hired a servant for the household work.

definition: an infectious disease caused by a virus, characterised by inflammatory swelling of the parotid and usu. other salivary glands; mumps.
example_en: The child caught mumps and the cheek swelled up.

definition: the climber vine Piper betle of Piperaceae family.
example_en: They used the betel vine's leaves for the worship.

definition: the organ of conception and gestation in a woman and other female mammals; the uterus; the womb.
example_en: The doctor examined the health of the womb.

definition: the wife of a leader, chieftain.
example_en: The chieftain's wife looked after her people with love.

definition: the grass Pennisetum typhoides (= Holcus spicata, = Panicum spicatum) of Poaceae family.
example_en: They let the cattle graze on kasake grass.

definition: a group of people; a crowd; a multitude.
example_en: A large crowd of people had gathered at the fair.

definition: a place of refuge.
example: ಅನಾಥ ಮಕ್ಕಳಿಗೆ ಆ ಆಶ್ರಮ ನೆಲೆ ಆಯಿತು.
example_en: That ashram became a place of refuge for the orphan children.

definition: the quality or condition of being clean, pure, spotless; cleanliness; immaculateness.
example: ಅಡುಗೆಮನೆಯ ಶುಚಿತನವನ್ನು ಅಜ್ಜಿ ಬಹಳ ಕಾಳಜಿಯಿಂದ ಕಾಪಾಡುತ್ತಾಳೆ.
example_en: Grandmother maintains the cleanliness of the kitchen with great care.

definition: a pillar erected as a monument of victory.
example_en: There is a stone victory pillar at the outskirts of the village.

definition: a moving around; movement; wandering.
example_en: His wandering about the streets in the evening was usual.

definition: to place a hedge around or along; to border or bound with a hedge; to hedge.
example_en: The farmer hedged around his field.

definition: a woman who works in or is skilled in the techniques of, any of the fine arts, esp. in painting, drawing, sculpture, drama, etc.
example_en: The skilled artist pleased everyone with her paintings.

definition: a loop formed in a rope, cord, etc. by means of a slipknot so that the loop tightens as the rope is pulled; a noose.
example_en: The hunter made a noose in the rope and tightened it.

definition: a falling short from fullness.
example_en: There was a partly-filled amount of water in the vessel.

definition: to become soft.
example: ಬಿಸಿಲಿಗೆ ಒಣಗಿದ ಚರ್ಮ ಎಣ್ಣೆ ಹಚ್ಚಿದ ಮೇಲೆ ಅದುಗಿತು.
example_en: The skin dried by the sun became soft after oil was applied.

definition: a narrow path.
example: ಆ ಇಱುಕುದಾರಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಜನ ಒಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ನಡೆಯಲಾಗದು.
example_en: Two people cannot walk together on that narrow path.

definition: the minister for defence of a country.
example: ಸೇನೆದಿವಾನರು ಗಡಿಯ ಭದ್ರತೆಯ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಸಭೆ ನಡೆಸಿದರು.
example_en: The defence minister held a meeting about border security.

definition: the state of being compactly and neatly arranged; compactness; neatness; tidiness.
example_en: The neat, compact arrangement of the bundles looked tidy.

definition: a sound or series of sounds made in lascivious mood.
example_en: Their lascivious sounds were heard in the silence of the night.

definition: a wretched, miserable life.
example_en: In poverty, his life became a wretched, miserable one.

definition: to lose courage, confidence, spirit or morale; to get disheartened.
example_en: Hearing the news of defeat, he lost heart.

definition: the condition of lying upside down or bottom portion up.
example_en: The child fell during play and lay upside down.

definition: a pitcher containing toddy.
example_en: He carried the pitcher of toddy home.

definition: the death anniversary of holy men of Muslim religion.
example_en: They celebrate the death anniversary of the holy man at the shrine every year.

definition: the remarriage of a widow.
example: ಆ ಸಮಾಜದಲ್ಲಿ ಸೀರುಡಿಕೆಗೆ ಈಗ ಒಪ್ಪಿಗೆ ಸಿಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.
example_en: In that society, widow remarriage is now getting acceptance.

definition: an anonymous woman.
example_en: No one knew who that anonymous woman was.

definition: the state of being a grandfather.
example_en: Grandfatherhood has come to him, and he plays with his grandchildren.

definition: a kitchen apparatus to flatten or roll chapatis or papads; a roller-pin.
example_en: Mother rolled the chapati with a rolling-pin.

definition: to rub, knead, etc. a part of the body, usu. with the hands, to stimulate circulation and make muscles or joints supple, relieve tension, etc.; to massage.
example_en: Grandfather got his aching leg massaged.

definition: the act, process or fact of being alive; a living; life.
example_en: His life passed on in poverty itself.

definition: to become abundant, superfluous.
example_en: Insects became abundant during the rainy season and were seen everywhere.

definition: difficulty or distress; vexation, affliction; trouble.
example: ಸಾಲದ ಘಸಣಿಯಿಂದ ಅವನು ರಾತ್ರಿ ನಿದ್ದೆ ಮಾಡಲಿಲ್ಲ.
example_en: He could not sleep at night due to the distress of debt.

definition: a deserted village or town.
example_en: After the war, that town became a deserted village.

definition: to divide (something) and distribute between or among.
example_en: The mother divided the sweets and distributed them to the children.

definition: the condition or fact of being restrained, restricted, regulated (by another); imprisonment; captivity.
example: ಸೆರೆಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅವನ ಕೈಬಸ ಬಹಳ ವರ್ಷ ಮುಂದುವರೆಯಿತು.
example_en: His captivity in prison continued for many years.

definition: a man who is plunged, sunk in or gone under the surface of.
example: ಆ ಮಗ್ನ ಪುರುಷ ನದಿಯ ಆಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಣ್ಮರೆಯಾದನು.
example_en: The man who was plunged under vanished into the depth of the river.

definition: an evil or mischievous spirit (believed by some that these are cursed beings of heaven).
example_en: The village people tell stories of the mischievous spirit.

definition: that which is beyond one's control or happens without being regulated.
example_en: The flood, an event beyond anyone's control, startled everyone.

definition: a young swan.
example_en: The young swan is playing in the water.

definition: uneasiness or discomfort of the mind.
example: ಆ ಸುದ್ದಿ ಕೇಳಿ ಅವನ ಮನಸ್ಸಿಗೆ ಎಡಂಬಡು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Hearing that news, his mind felt uneasy.

definition: to move slowly (as from fatigue).
example: ಬಳಲಿದ ಮುದುಕ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಕಾಲೆಳೆಯುತ್ತಾ ಮನೆ ಸೇರಿದನು.
example_en: The tired old man moved slowly, dragging his feet, and reached home.

definition: a shrill, high-pitched, harsh sound; screech.
example_en: The owl's screech pierced the silence of the night.

definition: a variety of mouse whose bite is poisonous.
example_en: If a poisonous mouse bites, call the doctor immediately.

definition: he who teaches, esp. whose occupation is to instruct; a teacher; a professional instructor.
example_en: The teacher (ovajja) answered the students' questions.

definition: that which causes obstruction; an obstacle; an interference.
example_en: This obstacle stopped our work.

definition: to slip down away from the hand, fingers, etc.; to escape from a hold, seizure.
example_en: The fish slipped away from his hand.

definition: the period of one day.
example_en: This work will not finish in a period of one day.

definition: a maid servant.
example_en: Maid servants were rendering service in the palace.

definition: to think; to assume (to be true); to suppose.
example_en: He assumed that matter to be true.

definition: a passage, as a tube, channel, etc. for water.
example_en: They built a water channel to irrigate the field.

definition: a contingent of policemen, armed force, etc. guarding a place.
example_en: There was an army guard post near the border.

definition: the helm - a) the wheel or tiller by which a ship or boat is steered; b) the complete steering gear, including the wheel or tiller, rudder, etc.
example_en: The helm of the old boat had broken.

definition: an act or art of making things beautiful; beautification.
example_en: The beautification of the house took place before the wedding.

definition: (pros.) a metre having three rhyming lines.
example_en: That verse is composed in the tividi metre.

definition: roasted meat.
example_en: The cook seasoned it with spices and prepared the roasted meat.

definition: a three-pronged spear; a trident.
example_en: The trident struck fear into the enemies in the battle.

definition: again; once more.
example_en: He made the same mistake again.

definition: a sickened or disgusted state of the mind.
example: ಆ ದೃಶ್ಯ ನೋಡಿ ಅವನಿಗೆ ತಲೆಕರಡು ಉಂಟಾಯಿತು.
example_en: Seeing that scene gave him a sickened, disgusted feeling.

definition: seriously; severely.
example_en: He was severely injured.

definition: (food) to change in the stomach and intestines by the action of gastric and intestinal juices, enzymes, into a form that can be absorbed by the body; to be digested.
example_en: Hot food gets digested quickly.

definition: any close-fitting head covering, either brimless or with a projecting brim, and made of wool, cotton, etc.; a cap.
example_en: In winter, the child wore a woollen cap.

definition: to exhibit braveness; to display one's courage.
example_en: That hero displayed his courage on the battlefield.

definition: excellent, unsurpassed beauty.
example: ಆ ನರ್ತಕಿಯ ಕಡುದೇಸಿಯನ್ನು ನೋಡಿ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ಮೂಕರಾದರು.
example_en: Everyone was struck dumb seeing the unsurpassed beauty of that dancer.

definition: one of the seven mother-goddesses.
example: ಪ್ರತಿ ವರ್ಷ ಚವುಡಿ ಜಾತ್ರೆ ವಿಜೃಂಭಣೆಯಿಂದ ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
example_en: Every year the Cavuḍi festival is held with great splendour.

definition: that which is pleasingly resplendent.
example_en: Her face was glowing with pleasing radiance.

definition: having a staff raised or held upwards.
example: ಆ ಉದ್ದಂಡ ಕೋಲನ್ನು ಹಿಡಿದ ಸಾಧುವಿಗೆ ಎಲ್ಲರೂ ನಮಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದರು.
example_en: Everyone bowed to the ascetic who held the upraised staff.

definition: a story made interesting by one's imagination.
example_en: Grandfather used to tell the children an imaginative story.

definition: a loose long cloth to cover the upper portion of the body or worn loosely above the upper garment.
example: ಆಕೆ ಸೀರೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಒಂದು ಸಲ್ಲೆ ಹೊದ್ದುಕೊಂಡಳು.
example_en: She wrapped a loose cloth over her sari.

definition: a kind of contagious, small pox characterised by red pustular eruptions on the skin.
example: ಮಗುವಿಗೆ ತಟ್ಟಮ್ಮ ಬಂದು ಮೈಯೆಲ್ಲ ಕೆಂಪು ಗುಳ್ಳೆಗಳಾದವು.
example_en: The child caught smallpox and red pustules appeared all over its body.

definition: the plant Cannabis sativa of Cannabinaceae family, grown for the tough fibre in its stem.
example: ಪೊಲೀಸರು ಆ ಮನೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಂಜಾ ಪತ್ತೆ ಮಾಡಿದರು.
example_en: The police found ganja in that house.

definition: a woman of such and such an age.
example_en: That woman of such age was skilled in household work.

definition: (gram.) (pl.) the five groups of five consonants each (kavarga, cavarga, ṭavarga, tavarga, and pavarga).
example: ವ್ಯಾಕರಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಂಚವರ್ಗ ಎಂದರೆ ಐದು ವ್ಯಂಜನ ಗುಂಪುಗಳು.
example_en: In grammar, panchavarga refers to the five groups of consonants.

definition: (rhet.) comparison of two objects, different from each other (considered one of the figures of speech); simile; comparison.
example_en: The simile in this poem is very beautiful.

definition: to be worshipped.
example_en: The Shiva-linga is worshipped every day.

definition: a thin, flat or bowl-shaped cake of batter fried in a frying pan; a pancake.
example_en: Grandmother made a pancake for breakfast.

definition: to be corrected or rectified.
example_en: His mistakes were corrected.

definition: to despise - a) to look down on with contempt and scorn; b) to regard with dislike or repugnance.
example_en: The rich used to despise the poor.

definition: to look through for the purpose of finding something; to search; to enquire about; to investigate.
example_en: The police searched for the lost child.

definition: a person who believes that there is no God; an atheist.
example_en: Though he is an atheist, he follows good conduct.

definition: soft, moist, slippery mud.
example_en: The children's feet sank into the soft, slippery mud.

definition: an alloy of copper with upto one-third tin; bronze.
example_en: The temple bell is made of bronze.

definition: weariness from physical or mental work; fatigue.
example_en: After working all day, fatigue overcame him.

definition: usage of a word (in speech or writing).
example_en: The usage of this word differs in the text.

definition: a word native to the language.
example_en: That word is a native Kannada word.

definition: to be anxious.
example_en: When her son was late in coming, the mother became anxious.

definition: (one's purpose, aim, objective) to be lost.
example_en: Due to the confusion, his purpose was lost.

definition: (turning, revolving) in a circular way and rapidly.
example_en: The kite rose up, spinning rapidly in a circle.

definition: a flint used to start fire by striking with a piece of steel.
example_en: He started a fire with the flint.

definition: the bony framework of the body; the structure of the bones; skeleton.
example_en: The doctor examined his skeleton in the X-ray.

definition: a man who throws or casts (an object) away; a thrower.
example_en: He was the one who objected to and rejected that proposal in the meeting.

definition: light; radiance; luminosity; brilliance.
example: ಆ ಮಣಿಯ ತ್ವಿಷೆ ಕತ್ತಲಲ್ಲೂ ಎದ್ದು ಕಾಣುತ್ತಿತ್ತು.
example_en: The radiance of that gem stood out even in the dark.

definition: to fish with a hook and line; to angle.
example: ಬೆಳಿಗ್ಗೆ ಅವನು ಕೊಳದ ದಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಗಾಳಹಾಕಿ ಕುಳಿತನು.
example_en: In the morning he sat at the pond's edge to fish with a hook and line.

definition: a lulling sound.
example_en: The grandmother cooed a lulling sound to her grandson.

definition: to cause to undergo combustion or be consumed partly or wholly by fire; to burn.
example_en: He was burning the dry leaves.

definition: a solemn promise or pledge dedicating oneself to an act, service or way of life; a vow; a pledge.
example: ಅವನು ದೇವರ ಮುಂದೆ ಹಣಿದ ಮಾಡಿ ಸೇವೆಗೆ ತೊಡಗಿದ.
example_en: He took a vow before God and began his service.

definition: to hold a conversation; to talk; to converse.
example_en: The two friends were conversing on the phone.

definition: the state or quality of being irreversible.
example_en: Everyone accepted the irreversibility of this decision.

definition: to prepare by or subject to a special process or method.
example_en: They process milk in the factory.

definition: the head, considered as the main part of the body.
example_en: In the battle, his head was wounded by the sword.

definition: a man on a police force, whose work is investigating and trying to solve crimes; a detective.
example_en: The detective uncovered the mystery of the murder case.

definition: any of echinoderms of Holothuroidea class, with an elongated, flexible, worm-like body and a mouth surrounded by tentacles; a sea cucumber; a holothurian.
example_en: The children held a sea cucumber in their hands and looked at it.

definition: to use, wield a weapon; to hit, injure or kill another with a weapon.
example_en: He wielded a weapon and struck the one who attacked him.

definition: a paste of saffron.
example_en: She applied a paste of saffron on her forehead.

definition: afterwards; subsequently.
example_en: After the rain stopped, the sky became clear afterwards.

definition: the plant Sida cordifolia ( = S. carpinifolia) of Malvaceae family.
example_en: People use the root of the Sida cordifolia plant for medicine.

definition: an unfortunate man; a man having bad luck.
example_en: The unfortunate man always faces difficulties.

definition: a rounded protuberance, esp. at the end or on the surface of a thing; a knob or the like.
example: ಪಾತ್ರೆಯ ಮುಚ್ಚಳದ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕುಪ್ಪು ಇತ್ತು.
example_en: There was a small knob on the lid of the vessel.

definition: small; tiny.
example_en: His piece of land is very small.

definition: a rich fabric as of silk, rayon or nylon with a soft, thick pile; velvet.
example_en: Red velvet cloth was being sold in the shop.

definition: to throw vehemently to a distant place.
example_en: He threw the stone vehemently to a distant place.

definition: that which transcends the speech; that which cannot be described by speech.
example_en: The glory of that god is beyond description by speech.

definition: photosynthesis - a) the biological synthesis of chemical compounds in the presence of light; b) the production of organic substances, chiefly sugars, from carbon dioxide and water occurring in green plant cells supplied with enough light to allow chlorophyll to aid in the transformation of the radiant energy into a chemical form.
example_en: Plants prepare food through photosynthesis.

definition: an open sore on the skin having number of tiny pores from which pus is discharged.
example_en: A lot of pus is oozing from the open sore.

definition: to regard as an inferior; to regard with contempt; to despise; to look down.
example_en: That rich man used to look down upon the poor with contempt.

definition: the fact of not being sanctioned, approved or permitted; rejection.
example_en: A rejection came from the department for his application.

definition: a state in the western part of India, with Gandhinagar as its capital.
example_en: Gujarat is a state in western India.

definition: a suprme woman leader; a female absolute leader; a supremo.
example: ಆ ಸಂಸ್ಥೆಯ ಕಟ್ಟೊಡತಿ ಎಲ್ಲರ ಗೌರವಕ್ಕೆ ಪಾತ್ರಳಾಗಿದ್ದಾಳೆ.
example_en: The supreme woman leader of that organization is respected by everyone.

definition: to cut, shape, carve by chiselling.
example_en: The sculptor chiselled the stone to make an idol.

definition: a Muhammadan priest.
example_en: The village kaji conducted prayers in the mosque.
